Subject: a beginner adult squire, about 22, short dark brown hair, attentive determined face, olive skin, slim athletic build. Worn oatmeal padded gambeson, plain brown belt, slate-blue short cloth tabard, dark trousers and scuffed leather boots; no plate armour or helmet. Holding one modest straight iron arming sword low in their right hand, blade tip pointed down, and one plain round wooden shield with iron central boss on their left forearm. Practical training equipment, visibly humble starting gear. Both arms relaxed away from torso enough to read each item clearly.
